description: Scalars as YAML 1.1 reads them, after a directive and a --- with a comment: null (~, null, nothing), booleans (yes, Off, TRUE), decimal integers (with _), floats (+.5, 6.02e23, 3.), and text for what is none of those (hex, 1:30, quoted numbers); comments after a space only; a plain value continued on more indented lines; single and double quotes with their escapes, folded over lines (a \ at the end joins without a space); literal and folded blocks with their chomping.

value.continued:
the first line and the second,
after an empty one
value.folded:
a line folded, and an
empty one kept
